title: Recommend with Reservations.
text: Recommend with Reservations.. I am a big fan of these "C" shaped neck pillows. My old one was fiber-fill, comfortable and got a lot of use. Sadly, we had a house fire and it was one of the items I had to replace. I decided to try the Memory Foam pillow. I have mixed feelings about this one. The shape is comfortable and supports my neck just fine. I am not a fan of the velour covering though. It feels scratchy, and I think it would feel too warm in the summer. The Memory Foam is okay. It feels a little too hard for complete comfort. I wish it had a little more give to it. So, I recommend this pillow with just these reservations. If you have skin that is sensitive to scratchy textures, overheat easily with things wrapped around your neck, or like a soft feel to your pillows, try something else. Otherwise, it is a great pillow that seems well-made and should last a long time.

product_metadata.title: Travelmate Memory Foam Neck Pillow, Dark Blue
features: The Best Pillow For Travel: unlike anything on the market, this patented, newly released and improved version has a built-in removable insert so you can adjust the thickness of the pillow based on your personal preference and sitting positions, preventing your head from being pushed forward. You now can sleep soundly even if you are sitting up on an airline seat with the help of this pillow! U.S. Patented.
Made of high quality, soft memory foam which molds perfectly to your neck (Size: 11 x 12 x 3.8 inches)
Zippered, machine-washable plush velour cover (Color: Dark Blue). Please note, we have never offered free or discounted products in exchange for an "honest and unbiased" review.
The built-in elastic strap makes it easy to attach the pillow to a carry-on luggage without taking up extra space. Great for travel or use for neck support anywhere you like.
